description: Make every failed upstream try and every abandoned request observable. Live evidence: ≈19 requests left no log row after the client aborted them at ~300 s; ≈19 same-provider retry failures were hidden; breaker-filtered providers were never logged; attempt rows had duration_ms=0 and a null reason because response_body_logging is off. Add a per-request attempt ledger on ActiveRequestHandle (replacing the `gateway_failed_attempts` response-extras channel), `duration_ms`/`error_class` on ProviderAttempt (never serialized to clients), an always-written `error_class` column in the request log, an abandoned-request outcome row (499 client_disconnect / 504 gateway_deadline) written from RequestCompleteGuard::drop, and a `pre_dispatch_ms` log field. Implements plan.md items 7-10 and DD7-DD9 and DD12. Depends on FEAT-001 (ChunkTimeout variant, the reader, new error classes).
steps: Item 7: in crates/ai-gateway/src/active_requests.rs, add #[serde(skip)] `failed_attempts: Vec<ProviderAttempt>`, `outcome_logged: bool` and `breaker_skips_recorded: bool` to ActiveRequestInfo (initialize them in handlers.rs build_active_request_info ~1326 and in the test samples). Add handle methods record_failed_attempt, failed_attempt_count, take_failed_attempts, mark_outcome_logged, outcome_logged, claim_breaker_skip_recording. In crates/ai-gateway/src/error/mod.rs, add `duration_ms: Option<u64>` and `error_class: Option<String>` to ProviderAttempt with #[serde(default, skip_serializing)], builder helpers, and `error_class_for(&GatewayError) -> String` per DD8. Add a test proving the AggregatedError JSON has no new keys. Test failed_attempt_ledger_records_and_drains.

Item 8: add `error_class: Option<String>` to LogEntry in crates/ai-gateway/src/logger/mod.rs. Add an additive column via the existing ensure_column migration and wire it into the INSERT (~821) and the SELECT/row-map (~865-935). Always store it regardless of body logging. Update every LogEntry literal (search `reasoning_compat_actions:` in src/ and tests/). Test error_class_column_migrates_and_round_trips.

Item 9: in router.rs dispatch_attempts_under_permit, record every failed HTTP try into `active` with duration_ms=request_start.elapsed(), status and error_class: TTFB/total/chunk timeouts, body read error, error-in-200, retryable status, non-retryable 4xx, 503, 429, network error, stream-truncated, and the stream_options 400. In route_with_failover_for_group, record budget/CB-open/cooldown/rate-limit skips and reasoning-only/empty/truncated failovers. In the Err arm, record only when the ledger did not grow during that provider's attempt_with_retry. Remove the three gateway_failed_attempts insertions (~6127, ~6280, ~6317). In route_request_with_exclusions, record circuit_open_skip (503) once per request (claim_breaker_skip_recording) for group members whose breaker is Open. Test ttfb_timeout_attempt_records_duration_and_error_class. Migrate the prior gateway_failed_attempts tests to the ledger.

Item 10: in crates/ai-gateway/src/gateway/handlers.rs, make log_failed_attempts consume `active_handle.take_failed_attempts()` and write duration_ms/error_class. Delete extract_failed_attempts, log_failed_attempts_from_response and the gateway_failed_attempts strip. Add `log_outcome(state, request, ctx, handle)` (log_request + mark_outcome_logged) and use it at every terminal log in chat_completions_non_stream, chat_completions_stream (early-event path, failover loop, early-event-disabled path), stream_buffered_with_post_call and stream_eager_structured_output, draining attempts on error paths too and setting error_class on error rows. Extend RequestCompleteGuard (~1268-1323) with an optional abandon logger (Arc logger, metrics, handle, requested model, kind, global deadline secs from state.runtime_limits). Drop writes one content-free outcome row when the guard was not completed and outcome_logged is false: 499 client_disconnect, or 504 gateway_deadline when elapsed >= deadline-1s; request_body None; short message in response_body, still subject to body logging. Then it drains the ledger. Add pre_dispatch_ms (now - started_at_ms) to the 'Calling provider' info logs in router.rs (~4285 buffered, ~8990 streaming), and an info log in preprocess_memory_request when it takes > 1 s.

Item 10 tests: new crates/ai-gateway/tests/request_outcome_logging.rs following tests/token_compression_observability.rs (server.build_router(), GET /dashboard/logs) and tests/common::isolate_databases: abandoned_stream_writes_client_disconnect_outcome_row (wiremock delayed 20 s; read the first SSE frame, drop the body, poll logs ≤5 s for status 499 + error_class client_disconnect), completed_stream_does_not_write_abandon_row, same_provider_retry_failure_is_logged_as_attempt_row (500 once then 200 → one #attempt row with status 500 and duration_ms>0), all_providers_failed_logs_attempt_rows.
acceptance_criteria: A request whose client disconnects mid-flight produces exactly one outcome row (status 499, error_class client_disconnect) plus #attempt rows for any failed tries (abandoned_stream_writes_client_disconnect_outcome_row passes).
A same-provider retry failure that is later rescued produces an #attempt row with real duration_ms and error_class (same_provider_retry_failure_is_logged_as_attempt_row passes).
All-providers-failed requests log per-attempt rows as well as the outcome row.
The client-visible AllProvidersFailed JSON is byte-for-byte unchanged in shape (error test passes); no gateway_failed_attempts key remains anywhere.
error_class is stored even when response_body_logging is false; legacy databases migrate.
cargo check -p ai-gateway --all-targets reports 0 warnings; lib tests and the new integration binary pass.
findings:

Extra (context.json no-regression set): prompt_cache_routing 7, reasoning_failover_compat 12, structured_output_integration 9, guardrail_streaming 5, guardrail_streaming_refusal 4, token_compression_e2e 4, virtual_keys_integration 13, all passed. Full `cargo test -p ai-gateway --lib` and the other integration binaries were not run (final gate). Nothing committed. Temp files deleted.

ACTIVE_REQUESTS (active_requests.rs): ActiveRequestInfo gained #[serde(skip)] `failed_attempts: Vec<ProviderAttempt>`, `outcome_logged: bool`, `breaker_skips_recorded: bool` (all 4 literal sites updated: handlers build_active_request_info, 2 router tests, active_requests test sample). ActiveRequestHandle methods: `record_failed_attempt(ProviderAttempt)`, `failed_attempt_count() -> usize`, `take_failed_attempts() -> Vec<ProviderAttempt>` (drains), `mark_outcome_logged()`, `outcome_logged() -> bool`, `claim_breaker_skip_recording() -> bool` (true once), plus `elapsed_ms() -> i64` (used for pre_dispatch_ms). Test active_requests::tests::failed_attempt_ledger_records_and_drains.

ERROR (error/mod.rs): ProviderAttempt gained `duration_ms: Option<u64>` and `error_class: Option<String>`, both #[serde(default, skip_serializing)]; builders `with_duration(Duration)` and `with_error_class(&str)`. `pub fn error_class_for(&GatewayError) -> String`: TtfbTimeout->ttfb_timeout, TotalTimeout->total_timeout, ChunkTimeout->chunk_timeout, Network/Http->network_error, RateLimitExceeded->rate_limit_skip, CircuitBreakerOpen->circuit_open_skip, SmartRoutingBudgetExceeded->budget_skip, AllProvidersFailed->last attempt's error_class (else other), Provider by message prefix ('Failed to read response body'->body_read_error, 'Error in 200 response'->error_in_200, 'Upstream stream ended before completion'->stream_truncated) else upstream_http_<status> else other; everything else other. Tests aggregated_error_json_has_no_internal_attempt_fields (attempt keys stay exactly error/model/provider/status_code/timestamp) and error_class_for_maps_router_errors.

LOGGER (logger/mod.rs): LogEntry.error_class: Option<String> (#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if none)]); `error_class TEXT` in CREATE TABLE + `ensure_column(conn, "error_class", "TEXT")`; INSERT ?26 and SELECT column 24. Not gated by body logging. 13 LogEntry literals updated (logger tests 10, dashboard tests 2, tests/token_compression_observability.rs 1). Test logger::tests::error_class_column_migrates_and_round_trips (legacy table without the column, body logging off, class stored, body dropped).

ROUTER (router.rs):
- Module fn `attempt_status_for(&GatewayError) -> u16` (DD8: timeouts 504, network 502, Provider status or 502, else status_code()).
- `Router::record_try_failure(active: Option<&ActiveRequestHandle>, provider, model, err: &GatewayError, class: Option<&str>, status: Option<u16>, started: std::time::Instant)` (associated fn, no self). class defaults to error_class_for(err), status to attempt_status_for(err), duration = started.elapsed(), error = err.to_string(). FEAT-003 can call it from route_request_streaming_excluding as `Self::record_try_failure(active.as_ref(), &provider_model.provider, &provider_model.model, &GatewayError::TtfbTimeout(ttfb_timeout_secs), None, None, request_start)` (or class Some("network_error")/status Some(502) for send errors; for 5xx pass a Provider{status_code: Some(code)} and class None -> upstream_http_<code>). Note: the streaming path has no ledger recording yet (DD11 is FEAT-003).
- `Router::push_attempt(&mut Vec<ProviderAttempt>, Option<&ActiveRequestHandle>, ProviderAttempt)` pushes to the client aggregate AND the ledger.
- `async fn record_breaker_skips(&self, &ModelGroup, selected: &[ProviderModel], Option<&ActiveRequestHandle>)` (DD12), called in route_request_with_exclusions right after the exclusion filter. Uses the read-only `cb.get_state()` (Open and opened_at.elapsed() < retry_after) so it never moves a breaker to half-open; claims claim_breaker_skip_recording only when it has something to record.
- dispatch_attempts_under_permit: local closure `record_try(&err, class, status, request_start)` defined before the retry loop; called at every failed try: TTFB timeout, read_upstream_body Err (Provider errors -> 502 body_read_error, timeouts 504), response.text() error (body_read_error 502), total timeout, both error-in-200 rate-limit returns (class error_in_200, status 200), the 200-envelope image-strip retry (error_in_200), error-in-200 retryable, SSE !completed (stream_truncated, 502), SSE ErrorFrame/ErrorFinish (error_in_200), SSE NoChunks and not-JSON-or-SSE parse failures (class other, 502), context-length truncation retry and its InvalidRequest return (upstream_http_<code>), OAuth 401 refresh retry/failure, DD4 stream:false fallback (upstream_http_400), 4xx image strip, reasoning strip, thinking-tagged 4xx return, plain 4xx return, 503 return, retryable status, network error (network_error, 502). `let http_class = format!("upstream_http_{status_code}")` is computed after the success branch.
- route_with_failover_for_group: budget/CB-open/cooldown/rate-limit skips and reasoning_only/empty_response/truncated_response failovers use push_attempt with classes budget_skip/circuit_open_skip/cooldown_skip/rate_limit_skip/reasoning_only/empty_response/truncated_response and duration from the per-provider start. `let ledger_before = active...failed_attempt_count()` before attempt_with_retry; the Err arm builds the attempt with duration + error_class_for(&e) and records it in the ledger only when the count did not grow (always pushes to the client aggregate). The three gateway_failed_attempts insertions are removed (and `mut` on `longest`).
- pre_dispatch_ms (handle.elapsed_ms, 0 without a handle) added to 'Calling provider' and 'Calling provider (streaming pass-through)' info logs.
- Router tests: ledger_handle() helper, ttfb_timeout_attempt_records_duration_and_error_class (also proves the Err-arm dedupe: 1 ledger entry), same_provider_retry_failure_is_recorded_in_ledger, breaker_prefilter_skip_is_recorded_once_per_request. No prior tests referenced gateway_failed_attempts (nothing to migrate); `gateway_failed_attempts` no longer appears anywhere in crates/.

HANDLERS (gateway/handlers.rs):
- RequestLogContext.error_class (from_error sets Some(error_class_for(error)); others None); log_request writes it.
- `log_outcome(state, request, ctx, handle: Option<&ActiveRequestHandle>)`: drain ledger -> log_failed_attempts, log_request, mark_outcome_logged. Every terminal log_request in chat_completions_non_stream, chat_completions_stream (early-event path, failover loop, early-event-disabled path), stream_eager_structured_output, stream_buffered_with_post_call and guardrail_error_response now calls log_outcome with `<guard>.active_handle()` (29 sites + guardrail_error_response + the previously unlogged streaming safety-cap path).
- `log_failed_attempts(logger: &RequestLogger, metrics: &Metrics, trace_id, &[ProviderAttempt])` writes duration_ms and error_class ("other" when absent). extract_failed_attempts, log_failed_attempts_from_response and the strip line are deleted.
- Pass-through relay failures (FailedBeforeContent truncation retry, pre-content failover, FailedAfterContent) are recorded on active_handle_stream via `relay_failure_attempt(provider, model, reason, elapsed)` / `relay_failure_class(reason)` (chunk_timeout/total_timeout/empty_response/stream_truncated/other); `relay_start` is taken at the top of each 'failover iteration. The classed attempt is also what goes into streaming_attempts, so the aggregated error's last error_class drives the outcome row class.
- RequestCompleteGuard gained `abandon: Option<AbandonLogger>`, `with_abandon_logger(AbandonLogger)` and `active_handle()`. `AbandonLogger::new(&state, &handle)` captures logger, handle, requested_model, kind and runtime_limits.request_timeout_seconds() (0 = disabled). Drop (only when not completed) calls log_abandoned: skips when outcome_logged, else marks it, drains the ledger into #attempt rows and writes one outcome row (path /v1/chat/completions, request_body None, provider/model from the handle, error_class client_disconnect/499 or gateway_deadline/504 via `abandon_outcome(elapsed, deadline_secs)` when elapsed_secs+1 >= deadline; response_body "<kind> request abandoned after Ns while on p/m, attempt N, phase P", still subject to body logging) plus an info log. Attached in chat_completions_non_stream and chat_completions_stream only. Cache-hit paths call complete() so they never write abandon rows.
- preprocess_memory_request logs 'Memory request preprocessing took longer than 1s' (elapsed_ms) at info around system.process_request.
- Tests gateway::handlers::tests::abandon_outcome_classifies_disconnect_vs_deadline and relay_failure_class_maps_relay_reasons.

INTEGRATION: new crates/ai-gateway/tests/request_outcome_logging.rs (JSON-deserialized config, common::isolate_databases, streaming emit_early_event=true + passthrough_enabled=false, GET /dashboard/logs): abandoned_stream_writes_client_disconnect_outcome_row (the SSE body is lazy, so the test polls it in a spawned task for 500 ms and aborts it to hang up), completed_stream_does_not_write_abandon_row, same_provider_retry_failure_is_logged_as_attempt_row (500 with 50 ms delay once, then 200), all_providers_failed_logs_attempt_rows (also asserts the client attempts JSON has no duration_ms/error_class).

NOTES FOR FEAT-003: (1) DD10 timeout no-retry: the TTFB/total/chunk `continue` sites already call record_try before `continue`; switching them to `return Err(err)` keeps the ledger correct (Err arm dedupe). (2) DD11: record in route_request_streaming_excluding with Self::record_try_failure as above; the buffered fallback then routes with the same handle, and record_breaker_skips will not double-record because of claim_breaker_skip_recording. (3) Admin parity: FEAT-002 adds no YAML option, so no admin-panel change. (4) No docs/wiki were changed.
